title: Delhi's Smog Towers Failed the Test. A 44-Year-Old Army Programme Didn't.

version_history.note: New article: what independent assessment actually found for Delhi's anti-pollution toolkit (Connaught Place + Jaipur smog towers, Metro vertical gardens, Army-linked afforestation, the Central Ridge/Nyaya Vatika controversy, and Zaara Biotech's untested Obelia algae bioreactor). Distinguishes ceremonial Army plantation drives from the Territorial Army's 1982 Ecological Task Force, the one intervention in the piece with a decades-long tracked survival rate. Chart: CPCB/CREA winter 2025-26 AQI-category day counts, lint-clean and render-verified.

version_history.reason: section expanded: two more algae-based air-purification ventures added, at the user's request
version_history.note: Section 6 originally covered only Zaara Biotech's Obelia (COP28-recognised, no independent performance data or named deployment). Added two more Indian algae ventures found via further research: Carbelim (Kochi-registered, IIT Madras-incubated, founded 2023, PureAir Tower and Biomimetic Facade products, no named public deployment found) and AlgaeTree/Mushroom World Group (founded 2024, the only one of the three with an actual named public deployment -- inaugurated 1 May 2026 at Bhopal's Swami Vivekananda Park under the Smart City programme, expanded July 2026 to IOCL's Vadodara refinery and Amanora Park Town, Maharashtra). Added a three-way comparison table and kept the same skepticism applied throughout the piece: all three companies' CO2-capture figures are company claims with no independent third-party measurement located, and AlgaeTree's real deployment confirms the units exist, not that the claimed capture rate holds. Updated the intro card, the Section 7 toolkit table, the caveats card and the sources card to match. Lint-clean, JS-parse-clean, 10/10 house rules.
